pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Cursed Metal Ingots come from Goety (the $(l:https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/goety)Goety$() mod's $(bold)goety:cursed_ingot$())$(li)Throw Cursed Metal Ingots into the Smeltery to melt them into $(bold)Molten Cursed Metal$() (90 mB per ingot, temperature 900)$(li)At the Casting Table, pour $(bold)90 mB$() of Molten Cursed Metal (1 ingot) to make a Cursed Metal part$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T2$() (secondary material, iron mining level).

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(bold)Magnetic$() (native to Tinkers): automatically attracts nearby drops and experience$(li)$(bold)Corruption$(): when an attack deals damage, spend 0.5% of your max soul energy (up to 100 per hit) to amplify that attack - every 5 soul adds +0.2 attack damage and +0.05 blocks of knockback (knockback stacks up to a 3-block cap); no boost when souls run short$(br2)Stats: head 293 durability / iron mining / 7.15 speed / 2.99 attack; bow limb draw -0.077 / initial speed +0.13; bow grip accuracy +0.13 / melee 3.25.
